classes.name: :Person
classes.label: Person
classes.description: A human user in the system. Typical questions: 'list all users', 'average age of users', 'users who live in the same city', 'friends of a person'.

classes.name: :Customer
classes.label: Customer
classes.description: A person who places orders. A customer is also a person. Typical questions: 'orders per customer', 'total spending of each customer'.

classes.name: :Employee
classes.label: Employee
classes.description: An employee working for the company, such as sales staff or warehouse managers. Typical questions: 'orders handled by each employee', 'employees per warehouse'.

classes.name: :City
classes.label: City
classes.description: A city where people live. Typical questions: 'users who live in London', 'number of users per city', 'friends living in the same city'.

classes.name: :Country
classes.label: Country
classes.description: A country that contains cities, warehouses, and customers. Typical questions: 'orders per country', 'customers by country'.

classes.name: :Address
classes.label: Address
classes.description: A physical address, usually associated with a person, warehouse, or shipment destination.

classes.name: :Product
classes.label: Product
classes.description: A product that can be purchased in the system. Typical questions: 'products with price greater than 100', 'average price per category', 'top 10 most expensive products'.

classes.name: :Brand
classes.label: Brand
classes.description: A brand or manufacturer of products. Typical questions: 'products of each brand', 'top brands by sales'.

classes.name: :Category
classes.label: Category
classes.description: A product category, such as 'Electronics', 'Books', or 'Clothing'. Typical questions: 'products in the Electronics category', 'number of products per category'.

classes.name: :Supplier
classes.label: Supplier
classes.description: A supplier providing products to the company. Typical questions: 'products from each supplier', 'total quantity purchased from a supplier'.

classes.name: :Warehouse
classes.label: Warehouse
classes.description: A warehouse where products are stored. Typical questions: 'inventory per warehouse', 'orders shipped from each warehouse'.

classes.name: :InventoryItem
classes.label: Inventory item
classes.description: An inventory record indicating the quantity of a product in a warehouse.

classes.name: :Order
classes.label: Order
classes.description: A purchase order placed by a customer. Typical questions: 'orders of each customer', 'orders with total amount greater than 1000', 'number of orders per city'.

classes.name: :OrderItem
classes.label: Order item
classes.description: An item within an order that refers to a specific product and quantity. Typical questions: 'products in an order', 'total quantity of each product sold'.

classes.name: :Payment
classes.label: Payment
classes.description: A payment made for an order. Typical questions: 'payment status of orders', 'total amount paid per customer'.

classes.name: :Invoice
classes.label: Invoice
classes.description: An invoice issued for an order. Typical questions: 'invoices per customer', 'unpaid invoices'.

classes.name: :Shipment
classes.label: Shipment
classes.description: A shipment that delivers an order to a destination. Typical questions: 'shipments per warehouse', 'late shipments'.

classes.name: :Cart
classes.label: Cart
classes.description: A shopping cart belonging to a customer. Typical questions: 'items in a cart', 'abandoned carts'.

classes.name: :CartItem
classes.label: Cart item
classes.description: An item inside a shopping cart referencing a product and quantity.

classes.name: :Review
classes.label: Review
classes.description: A text review written by a customer about a product. Typical questions: 'reviews for a given product', 'customers who wrote reviews'.

classes.name: :Rating
classes.label: Rating
classes.description: A numeric rating (for example 1–5 stars) given by a customer to a product.

classes.name: :Tag
classes.label: Tag
classes.description: A tag or label attached to a product, such as 'bestseller', 'new', 'discounted'.

classes.name: :Currency
classes.label: Currency
classes.description: A currency such as USD, EUR, or VND. Typical questions: 'total sales in each currency'.

classes.name: :Discount
classes.label: Discount
classes.description: A discount or promotion applied to an order or product.

properties.name: :hasName
properties.label: name
properties.description: The name of a person, customer, employee, or product. Example questions: 'list user names', 'names of all products', 'customers whose name starts with A'.

properties.name: :hasEmail
properties.label: email
properties.description: The email address of a person or customer. Example questions: 'find emails of all customers', 'list users with missing email (OPTIONAL)'.

properties.name: :hasPhone
properties.label: phone number
properties.description: The phone number of a person, customer, or supplier.

properties.name: :hasAge
properties.label: age
properties.description: The age of a person in years. Typical questions: 'users older than 18', 'average age of users', 'youngest or oldest user age'.

properties.name: :livesIn
properties.label: lives in
properties.description: Links a person to the city they live in. Typical questions: 'users who live in London', 'users living in the same city', 'number of users per city'.

properties.name: :cityInCountry
properties.label: city in country
properties.description: Links a city to its country. Typical questions: 'cities in each country', 'orders grouped by country via the city of the customer'.

properties.name: :hasAddress
properties.label: has address
properties.description: Links a person, customer, warehouse, or supplier to an address.

properties.name: :streetLine
properties.label: street line
properties.description: Street line of an address, for example '221B Baker Street'.

properties.name: :postalCode
properties.label: postal code
properties.description: Postal or ZIP code of an address.

properties.name: :friendOf
properties.label: friend of
properties.description: Friendship relationship between two persons. Typical questions: 'friends of a given user', 'create friendship relations between people who live in the same city'.

properties.name: :employedAt
properties.label: employed at
properties.description: Links an employee to the warehouse or company where they work.

properties.name: :hasBrand
properties.label: has brand
properties.description: Links a product to its brand.

properties.name: :productName
properties.label: product name
properties.description: The human-readable name of a product. Typical questions: 'list product names', 'products whose name contains "phone"'.

properties.name: :sku
properties.label: SKU
properties.description: Stock keeping unit identifier of a product.

properties.name: :hasPrice
properties.label: product price
properties.description: The base price of a product. Typical questions: 'products with price greater than 100', 'average product price per category'.

properties.name: :inCategory
properties.label: in category
properties.description: Links a product to its category. Typical questions: 'products in the Electronics category', 'number of products per category'.

properties.name: :suppliedBy
properties.label: supplied by
properties.description: Links a product to its supplier.

properties.name: :warehouseFor
properties.label: warehouse for
properties.description: Links an inventory item to the warehouse it belongs to.

properties.name: :inventoryOfProduct
properties.label: inventory of product
properties.description: Links an inventory item to the product being stocked.

properties.name: :quantityInStock
properties.label: quantity in stock
properties.description: Quantity of a product currently in stock at a warehouse.

properties.name: :placedOrder
properties.label: placed order
properties.description: Links a customer to an order they placed. Typical questions: 'orders for each customer', 'customers who placed more than 5 orders'.

properties.name: :orderDate
properties.label: order date
properties.description: The date and time when an order was placed. Typical questions: 'orders in the last 30 days', 'orders placed in 2024'.

properties.name: :orderTotal
properties.label: order total
properties.description: The total monetary amount of an order. Typical questions: 'orders with total amount greater than 1000', 'maximum order total', 'average order total per customer'.

properties.name: :orderCurrency
properties.label: order currency
properties.description: Currency in which the order is charged.

properties.name: :hasItem
properties.label: has item
properties.description: Links an order to its order items. Typical questions: 'items of each order', 'products contained in an order'.

properties.name: :itemOfProduct
properties.label: item of product
properties.description: Links an order item to the product it refers to. Typical questions: 'products sold in each order', 'total quantity sold per product'.

properties.name: :quantity
properties.label: quantity
properties.description: The quantity of a product in an order item or cart item. Typical questions: 'total quantity of each product sold', 'order items with quantity greater than 10'.

properties.name: :unitPrice
properties.label: unit price
properties.description: The price per unit of a product in an order item.

properties.name: :forOrder
properties.label: payment for order
properties.description: Links a payment to the order it pays for.

properties.name: :paymentMethod
properties.label: payment method
properties.description: Payment method such as credit card, bank transfer, or cash.

properties.name: :paymentStatus
properties.label: payment status
properties.description: Status of a payment, such as 'pending', 'completed', 'failed'.

properties.name: :paidAmount
properties.label: paid amount
properties.description: The amount of money actually paid in a payment.

properties.name: :invoiceForOrder
properties.label: invoice for order
properties.description: Links an invoice to the order it is issued for.

properties.name: :invoiceNumber
properties.label: invoice number
properties.description: Invoice identifier.

properties.name: :invoiceDate
properties.label: invoice date
properties.description: Date when the invoice was issued.

properties.name: :shipmentForOrder
properties.label: shipment for order
properties.description: Links a shipment to the order it delivers.

properties.name: :shippedFrom
properties.label: shipped from warehouse
properties.description: Warehouse from which a shipment is sent.

properties.name: :shippedTo
properties.label: shipped to address
properties.description: Address where a shipment is delivered.

properties.name: :shipmentDate
properties.label: shipment date
properties.description: Date when the shipment was sent.

properties.name: :deliveredDate
properties.label: delivered date
properties.description: Date when the shipment was delivered.

properties.name: :trackingNumber
properties.label: tracking number
properties.description: Tracking number of a shipment.

properties.name: :cartOfCustomer
properties.label: cart of customer
properties.description: Links a cart to the customer it belongs to.

properties.name: :cartHasItem
properties.label: cart has item
properties.description: Links a cart to its cart items.

properties.name: :cartItemProduct
properties.label: cart item product
properties.description: Links a cart item to the product it refers to.

properties.name: :cartItemQuantity
properties.label: cart item quantity
properties.description: Quantity of the product in the cart item.

properties.name: :reviewOfProduct
properties.label: review of product
properties.description: Links a review to the product it is about.

properties.name: :reviewByCustomer
properties.label: review by customer
properties.description: Links a review to the customer who wrote it.

properties.name: :reviewText
properties.label: review text
properties.description: Text content of a review.

properties.name: :ratingValue
properties.label: rating value
properties.description: Numeric rating value given by a customer to a product (for example, from 1 to 5).

properties.name: :ratingForProduct
properties.label: rating for product
properties.description: Links a rating to the product it evaluates.

properties.name: :ratingByCustomer
properties.label: rating by customer
properties.description: Links a rating to the customer who gave it.

properties.name: :taggedWith
properties.label: tagged with
properties.description: Links a product to a tag.

properties.name: :tagName
properties.label: tag name
properties.description: Name of a tag such as 'bestseller', 'new', 'discounted'.

properties.name: :discountPercent
properties.label: discount percent
properties.description: Discount percentage applied to an order or product.

properties.name: :discountForOrder
properties.label: discount for order
properties.description: Links a discount to an order it is applied to.

properties.name: :discountForProduct
properties.label: discount for product
properties.description: Links a discount to a product it is applied to.
